## ARTHRITIS ASSOCIATED WITH LYME DISEASE
Arthritis is a common manifestation of late-stage Lyme Disease. Consult
Infectious Diseases or Rheumatology if symptoms persist or recur after
completing antimicrobial treatment.
## Treatment
Preferred:
## Inpatient/##Outpatient

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI] for 28 days](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
For pregnant patients or those with contraindications to doxycycline:
[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h ($) [R] for 28 days](psjzid-amoxicillin-500mg-po-q8h)
